auditMetadata.auditTitle: Operational Permissions & Smart Roster Import Forensic Audit
auditMetadata.environment: Production Cloud Run / Firebase Firestore Sandbox

rootCauseAnalysis.autoProvisioning: When new Google Auth users sign in for the first time without prior admin provision, authContext.tsx provisions a default profile with role VIEWER and assignedProjectIds [].
rootCauseAnalysis.clientRoleSwitcherIllusion: The header role selector in App.tsx updates React state currentRole in the browser UI, but Firestore Security Rules execute server-side on Google Cloud evaluating the actual document in /users/{uid}.
rootCauseAnalysis.authorizationMismatch: Since /users/tnvNvIwUdgSrud72N38LhJfBlhw2 has role VIEWER and assignedProjectIds [], hasProjectRole('Q-PRJ-001', ['PROJECT_ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']) evaluates to false.

rosterPermissionErrorDiagnosis.securityRuleClause: match /projects/{projectId}/roster/{rosterId} { allow create, update: if isSignedIn() && isValidId(rosterId) && hasProjectRole(projectId, ['PROJECT_ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']) && ...; }
rosterPermissionErrorDiagnosis.denialReason: User tnvNvIwUdgSrud72N38LhJfBlhw2 lacks PROJECT_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role in Firestore /users collection and Q-PRJ-001 is missing from assignedProjectIds.

driveSelectorRegressionAnalysis.issue: Manual folder name/ID input still exposed in UI despite BLOCK 100G-D specifications.
driveSelectorRegressionAnalysis.rootCause: Wizard Phase 6 and Workspace settings retained legacy text input elements alongside the new Enterprise Drive Picker, creating UI confusion.
driveSelectorRegressionAnalysis.remediationRequirement: Replace raw text inputs with the Enterprise Folder Selector modal as primary UX, automatically resolving folder IDs via server-side API calls.

intelligentParsingCapabilities.columnAliasing: Supports Arabic & English header variations (اسم السائق, رقم الهوية, رقم اللوحة, driverName, truckPlate, etc.)
intelligentParsingCapabilities.normalization: Normalizes names, Saudi phone numbers (+966), 10-digit National ID/Iqama, and Saudi license plate numbers.
intelligentParsingCapabilities.entityResolution: Matches drivers and trucks against known project entities with confidence scoring (100 = Exact, 90 = Normalized, 75 = Fuzzy).
intelligentParsingCapabilities.conflictDetection: Detects DRIVER_CARRIER_CONFLICT and RELATIONSHIP_CONFLICT if driver or truck is registered to a different carrier.

reviewBeforeCommitWorkflow.inMemoryProcessing: Stages 1-8 (PARSE -> NORMALIZE -> MAP -> RESOLVE -> VALIDATE -> DUPLICATE_CHECK -> REVIEW) execute entirely in client memory with zero Firestore side effects.
reviewBeforeCommitWorkflow.commitGating: Writing to Firestore only occurs during Stage 9 (COMMIT) after explicit user confirmation of reviewed rows.

entityAndIdLogicVerification.globalDriverId: DRV-IMP-{timestamp}-{hash} (Stored in drivers collection, linked to primary carrierId)
entityAndIdLogicVerification.projectRosterId: RST-{hash} (Stored in projects/{projectId}/roster/{rosterId}, links carrier, driver, truck, and allowed materialIds to specific project scope)
entityAndIdLogicVerification.materialAssignmentScope: Roster records specify allowed materialIds from projects/{projectId}/materials to bound weighbridge ticket operations.

recommendations: Assign PROJECT_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role and Q-PRJ-001 to user profile in /users/tnvNvIwUdgSrud72N38LhJfBlhw2 in Firestore.
Consolidate Google Drive storage selection UX across Step6GoogleDrive.tsx and WorkspaceIntegrationView.tsx into the unified Enterprise Folder Picker.
Verify Roster creation via AdminConsole or user management tooling once role permissions are updated.
